concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a tall LEAF-WIND OWL GENERAL, the SECOND stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: a chubby sage-green owl with a cream face mask, leaf ear tufts and amber eyes, in the same view and pose as image 1, standing tall in a long leaf cloak, its two wings spread wide to both sides like open arms, a bamboo ring behind its back and a big spinner hovering on each side of the cloak's hem, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 owl general head with face; 2 feathered chest; 3 layered leaf cloak; 4 two wing-arms; 5 two wing-tip feather fans; 6 two owl feet; 7 two maple-seed spinners; 8 bamboo ring with wind ribbons;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 owl general head with face: an owl general's head, same place and about the same size: a round head of sage-green feathers; a big heart-shaped warm cream facial mask where the green visor is, with two big amber eyes (one small catchlight dot each), brows angled down, a small hooked olive-brown beak and a confident smirk; two sage-green leaf ear tufts rising from the top of the head where the tall leaf crest and the curled tendril are; the two long hanging ribbons become two long sage-green leaf-feather lappets of the owl's hood hanging down both sides of the chest, same place and length, with darker sage leaf tips; no helmet, no visor, no gold, no pink ornament, no human face, no hair.
2 feathered chest: the owl general's chest: a cream feathered chest with small scalloped feather marks where the torso is; the pink bow becomes a fluffy cream feather ruff of leaf-shaped tufts at the throat; the dark cape piece behind the shoulders becomes the inside of the leaf cloak in darker sage with two sage leaf tips; no pink, no red leaf, no turquoise collar.
3 layered leaf cloak: a long cloak of overlapping big leaf-shaped feathers in sage green and darker sage, each with a thin midrib and a few vein lines, layered like a leaf cape down to the ground; the hip pieces are a shorter upper layer of the same leaves with cream feather edges; no pink, no yellow patches.
4 two wing-arms: two sage-green feathered owl wings spread like open arms, same pieces, bends and directions: shoulder at the inner end, wrist at the outer end, rows of layered feathers in sage and darker sage along each wing; the two bangles become two narrow pale bamboo cuffs with olive node lines; no light-blue skin, no pink.
5 two wing-tip feather fans: the owl's wing tips: a fan of four long primary feathers spread like fingers, sage green with cream tips and a darker sage midrib, where the old hands are and about the same size; no hands, no fingers, no light blue.
6 two owl feet: two small owl feet peeking out under the cloak, sage-feathered with three short dark-olive talons each; no pink, no buds.
7 two maple-seed spinners: two big maple-seed spinners (the first stage's spinners grown bigger): three winged maple seeds joined at a round olive-brown seed knot like a three-blade propeller, papery pale tan-green seed wings with fine vein lines, the knot where the old flower centre is, about the size of the old flower; no petals, no orange.
8 bamboo ring with wind ribbons: a big round ring of pale bamboo (pale straw-green with darker olive node rings every few segments), same size and place, with two white wind ribbons spiralling around it (ink outline, a few pale blue-grey swirl lines, flowing curled ends) and a few small sage leaves along its lower part; no wood grain, no vines, no glow.

ATTITUDE: a calm, commanding owl general: brows angled down, a steady amber stare, a confident smirk under its beak; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: sage-green feathers (soft grey-green) with darker sage leaf-shaped feathers, a warm cream face mask, chest and feather tips, big amber eyes, a small olive-brown beak, pale tan-green maple seed spinners with olive-brown knots, a pale bamboo ring with olive node rings, white wind ribbons, dark-olive talons. Few colours.

AVOID: a human face or body, human hair, a big leaf hat or helmet with a gold rim, a pink gem, orange flowers, turquoise, mint or light-blue colours, light-blue skin, sleeves or hands, pink bows or bangles, a wooden ring with vines, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
